races.paceDynamic: With all 11 runners categorized as hold-up performers and no confirmed front runner, this race will drift into a crawling pace through the early stages. Pride Of Nepal and Knightmare may reluctantly take it along, but neither wants to make the running, creating a tactical cat-and-mouse affair. The lack of pace will compress the field turning for home, leading to a mad scramble in the final 2-3 furlongs where positioning and a clear run become crucial. This tactical setup strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can quicken sharply from off the pace when the real racing begins.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Burn Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If no horse commits to making the running early and they crawl through halfway
scenarios.body: The pace will be funeral-slow until the 3f pole when multiple horses try to kick simultaneously, creating a cavalry charge finish. Horses with the best tactical speed and clearest passage will prevail in this sprint-finish scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the compressed field creates interference turning for home
scenarios.body: With 11 horses bunched together after slow early fractions, several runners will get stopped for room or forced wide. The winner will be one of the few who gets a dream run through or finds gaps at crucial moments.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Horse Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Pride Of Nepal gets the perfect trip from his hold-up position
scenarios.body: Despite the messy pace scenario, the highest-rated runner will use superior ability to overcome the tactical puzzle. His recent wins show he can handle these tactical affairs when things fall right.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites get caught up in early positioning battles
scenarios.body: While the market leaders jostle for position in the middle stages, a patient outsider will be held up out the back and delivered with one late run. The slow pace will set up perfectly for this type of surprise winner.

races.paceDynamic: Man Is King will likely take charge early with his front-running style, setting a steady gallop without pressure from other early leaders. Artavian and Offiah's Boy may track prominently but neither appears likely to force the issue. The large hold-up contingent including San Francisco Bay, Little She, and Change Of Fortune will need Man Is King to soften up over this staying trip on testing ground. This race shape strongly favours the early pace-setters who can dictate terms, particularly Man Is King who can control the tempo without harassment.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Man Is King Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Man Is King gets an uncontested lead and maintains his recent winning form.
scenarios.body: He can dictate a steady pace that plays to his strengths while the hold-up horses struggle to pick up the pieces on soft ground. His fitness edge from a recent win 10 days ago becomes crucial in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Artavian and Offiah's Boy press Man Is King for the early lead.
scenarios.body: The increased pace exposes stamina limitations but creates opportunities for the better prominent racers who can stay in touch. Artavian's trainer struggles but the horse has shown ability in similar conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses and becomes too steady for the conditions.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the fresher hold-up horses can utilise their turn of foot. San Francisco Bay and Little She benefit from the tactical scenario despite their usual need for stronger gallops.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Emerges Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace and ground combine to level the playing field completely.
scenarios.body: The handicap weights and amateur jockey factor create chaos in the final furlong where lesser-fancied runners find gaps. Change Of Fortune's trainer hits form and local connections provide the edge.

races.paceDynamic: Connie's Rose will set the pace from the gates with no other natural pace-setters in this field of predominantly hold-up horses. The Harris mare won't face any early pressure, allowing her to dictate proceedings at a manageable gallop through the opening furlongs. With six hold-up horses (Moostar, Level Up, Savannah Smiles, Fletcher's Flight, Sonic Si, Some Nightmare) all needing to come from off the pace, they'll be bunched together seeking racing room in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours the pace-setter and any horse that can secure an early prominent position, as the hold-up brigade will face traffic problems in a congested finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Connie's Rose gets an easy lead and maintains her kick
scenarios.body: She controls the tempo completely and has enough left to resist the late challengers who get trapped behind horses. The 5f trip on soft ground becomes a tactical advantage rather than a stamina test when you're not fighting for position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Class
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses find clear racing room despite the congestion
scenarios.body: Moostar's higher rating and Watson's ability to find gaps allows him to power through, with the better horses asserting late. The pace becomes fast enough to set up the finishers despite the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Connie's Rose goes too slow and gets swamped by the field
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses all get competitive simultaneously but the lack of early pace means it becomes a sprint finish. Fletcher's Flight's recent Chepstow win gives him the confidence edge in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace judgement goes wrong and creates gaps for overlooked runners
scenarios.body: Some Nightmare's light weight and Savannah Smiles' trainer form combine with others struggling tactically. The race becomes messy enough for unconsidered horses to pick up the pieces.

races.paceDynamic: Hint Of The Jungle will lead from the gates with his prominent running style, setting a sustainable gallop in this small field of nine. With soft ground favouring sustained finishing kicks and no genuine pace pressure on Too Much Trevor, this sets up perfectly for the closers to time their runs. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late finishing speed.

scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter exploits the field's reluctance to commit early and builds an unassailable lead. Too Much Trevor's recent winning form suggests he has the class edge when getting his own way.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses bunch together and create interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Early positioning becomes crucial as several closers struggle for racing room in the sprint home. Horses drawn favorably or ridden more aggressively gain decisive advantages through cleaner passages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Pace Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Whitesnake or another runner unexpectedly pressures Too Much Trevor early
scenarios.body: The increased gallop sets up a completely different tactical scenario where mid-division horses benefit. The early pace battle compromises both leaders and sets up alternatives with different running styles.
